generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, reflective practice is the discipline the whole field runs on. Supervision, appraisal, placement portfolios, clinic logs and the records a professional body requires all rest on it: examining your own practice honestly, weighing it against the standards of your sport subject, and acting on what you find. Treat what follows as being about your own developing practice as a sport scientist, coach, therapist or manager, not about reflection in the abstract.
